tweet.text:
The more I press on Gerkin style specifications for AI, the less I trust them.  The AI will happily claim to be passing all the Gerkin tests, while in reality implementing them to silently pass while testing nothing.  

Nothing can be trusted other than direct human inspection at the code level.  And that inspection must be deeply suspicious of the lies the AI will tell and the ways that it will hide it's misbehavior.
